title: A custom ControlsFactory gets the same full-diagram sync hook as the built-in control bar

v:
Raised by the standards review of board-full-diagram-toggle T3. Tracked as issue
`01M4G5ZCG041NAZW19CDY5KEER` (backlog, blocked on this decision). Bears on ADR-0006
(decision `01M4GA3B7SBRN7C5G52Y4PSAJX`), whose built-in control bar is meant to be replaceable.

## Problem

The built-in control bar stays in step with the board through a private `syncFullDiagram`
channel. A custom `ControlsFactory` cannot reach it: it can only use the board-level
`onFullDiagramChange` option and update its own buttons from outside the factory (the README
example has to hoist its button references for this). The built-in bar therefore can no longer
be written as an ordinary `ControlsFactory`, which weakens ADR-0006's "replaceable".

## Options

- **A** — `ControlsFactory`'s return value gains an optional `onFullDiagramChange?(on: boolean)`.
  The board calls it for every control bar, and the built-in bar moves onto the same path.
  Amends ADR-0006.
- **B** — Keep the current design and add a note to ADR-0006 explaining why the built-in bar
  has a private sync channel.

## Write ownership if accepted

`packages/board/src/createBoard.ts`, `defaultControls.ts`, `createBoard.test.ts`, `README.md`,
`CHANGELOG.md`, and ADR-0006.
